name: field-coach
description: Field Coach lead mapping, field sessions, coaching, sales tracking, and organization-managed operations app from McCoy Platform LLC.

scripts.mobile:android:prepare: npm run mobile:web && rm -rf android && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --assetPath assets --iconBackgroundColor '#050607' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#050607' --splashBackgroundColor '#050607' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#050607' && node scripts/configure-native-project.mjs android
scripts.mobile:ios:prepare: npm run mobile:web && rm -rf ios && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios && npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios --assetPath assets --iconBackgroundColor '#050607' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#050607' --splashBackgroundColor '#050607' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#050607' && node scripts/configure-native-project.mjs ios
